entities.summary: Nurlan Baiuzakuly Yermekbayev is a Kazakh politician, diplomat and Lieutenant General in the Ground Forces who had been the Minister of Defense of Kazakhstan from 7 August 2018 to 31 August 2021. Ermekbaev's diplomatic rank is of Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary.
